transcript.text: AEG IKB64301FB induction hob keeps beeping and showing Er03 then switches off. Pan of pasta boiled over just before.

[Heading: Hob's cooling / ventilation]
An induction hob switching itself off when hot is usually its overheat protection. Please check that nothing is blocking the gap under the hob, such as a drawer packed tight or no ventilation gap above an oven. If it keeps happening, the cooling fan or a sensor needs an appliance engineer to look at it. I am not recommending a part from this.
Nothing's blocking underneath as far as I know, but it wasn't hot, it went off right when the pasta water spilled over the controls. Does that change things?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Water near the plug or socket is dangerous. Please don't touch the plug, socket or machine if they or your hands are wet. If you can do it safely, switch off the circuit at the consumer unit (fuse box), keep away from the water, and don't use the machine again until a qualified electrician or appliance engineer has checked it.
